items.title: Cord Blood-Derived Fibroblast Activation Protein-Targeted Chimeric Antigen Receptor Natural Killer Cells Persist in Vivo.
items.one_liner: Cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) have been recognized as key contributors to tumor progression. Chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cell therapy targeting fibroblast activation protein (FAP), a marker of CAFs, has gained attention and is being evaluated in both preclinical and clinical studies. items.title: AATRhg1 is a tonoplast protein that alters amino acid, metabolic and defense responses and nematode resistance.
items.one_liner: Soybean cyst nematode (SCN, Heterodera glycines) causes significant soybean yield losses. The Rhg1 locus is a major contributor to SCN resistance and contains three genes that mediate this trait including Rhg1-GmAAT (Glyma.18G022400), which encodes the putative amino acid transporter AATRhg1.
